Alex — thanks for the checklist and the clarity.

We can support either approach, but for NovaBank's private VPC endpoints we usually recommend the signed CSR approach paired with a short-lived cert to avoid TTL/replication issues with private DNS. That said, adding a TXT record is often faster if you control the zone.

Quick proposal:
- We prepare a CSR (offline) and deliver the PEM to you for validation by EOD Thu (2026-09-16).
- If you prefer immediate DNS proof, we can provide a challenge token by EOD Wed (2026-09-15) that you can place as a TXT record under api-internal.novabank.local.

Cc'ing Jonas and Karthik to confirm the CSR format we should use and any additional metadata NovaBank's audit needs.

Eve / Karthik —

Short notes on technical constraints and the recommended flow:

- CSR format: RFC 2986 PEM-encoded CSR is fine. Include CN=api-internal.novabank.local and SANs for the internal aliases (api-int.novabank.local). We should also add an orgUnit=redwood-inference-proxy in the subject to make auditing straightforward for NovaBank.

- Generation: For highest security, generate the CSR on a short-lived build host (or HSM) and never export the private key. If NovaBank needs us to sign and provide the cert, we'll sign with the private CA used for Private deployments and produce a cert with 30-day validity.

- DNS alternative: If NovaBank chooses TXT proof, ask them to create a TXT record under _rdw-verify.api-internal.novabank.local with token: rdw-20260915-7f3b. Our validation script queries the private resolver within the VPC. Note that split-horizon zones can take ~5–15 minutes to converge depending on the customer's DNS replication cadence.

- Automation hooks: We'll upload the cert to the private endpoint via our control plane (private API) and run the same automated health checks NovaBank uses for their internal services.

I'll draft the CSR and an example command snippet for generation. Karthik — can you create the PEM and the short playbook we use for customers?

Jonas
Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference

Alex, Evelyn — attaching the CSR we discussed and a short playbook for the CSR exchange and cert installation.

What I've attached:
- csr_redwood_vpc_20260916.pem  (PEM-encoded CSR, CN=api-internal.novabank.local)
- private-host-csr-playbook.pdf (step-by-step: verify TXT challenge, CSR generation commands, cert upload to private control plane)

Command snippet used to generate CSR locally (example):

openssl req -new -sha256 -nodes -out csr_redwood_vpc_20260916.pem -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout private_key.pem -subj "/C=US/ST=CA/L=San Francisco/O=Redwood Inference/OU=redwood-inference-proxy/CN=api-internal.novabank.local" -reqexts SAN -config <(cat /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf 
[req]
distinguished_name=req_distinguished_name
req_extensions=req_ext
[req_distinguished_name]
[req_ext]
subjectAltName=DNS:api-internal.novabank.local,DNS:api-int.novabank.local)

Notes: we do not export the private key. If NovaBank prefers to generate their own CSR inside their HSM, we can accept that and provide the challenge token instead.

Attachments: csr_redwood_vpc_20260916.pem, private-host-csr-playbook.pdf
